description: Test harness configuration contract — runner pinned, coverage explicit, CI-ready reporters, no infinite timeouts

rules.title: Runner version pinned
rules.description: Test runner must be in devDependencies with an exact version — no ^ or ~ range specifiers

rules.title: Coverage provider explicit
rules.description: coverage.provider must be 'v8' or 'istanbul' — not left to runner default

rules.title: No infinite timeouts
rules.description: All test environments must declare a finite timeout > 0

rules.title: JUnit reporter required
rules.description: reporters array must include a JUnit-compatible reporter for CI ingestion

rules.title: Mock strategy declared
rules.description: mockStrategy must be one of: msw, jest.mock, vi.spyOn, manual, nock, sinon
